overview: The Smurfs is a 2011 American fantasy comedy film based on the comic book series created by Peyo. Directed by Raja Gosnell and written by J. David Stem, David N. Weiss, Jay Scherick, and David Ronn, from a story by Stem and Weiss, it is the first installment of the live-action animated Smurfs film series. The film stars Neil Patrick Harris, Jayma Mays, Sofía Vergara, and Hank Azaria, with the voices of Jonathan Winters, Katy Perry, George Lopez, Anton Yelchin, Fred Armisen, and Alan Cumming.
